stories.title: Manifest Snapshot Metadata Schema
stories.description: Define and standardize manifest snapshot metadata including generated_at timestamp, file_hashes (SHA-256), build_id, and configurable freshness TTL used to determine validity prior to any execution.

stories.title: Snapshot Freshness Validation Engine
stories.description: Implement core validation logic that evaluates manifest freshness by checking TTL expiry and detecting hash drift against current file state using manifest_generator hashing behavior.

stories.title: Auto-Regeneration Trigger on Stale Manifest
stories.description: Integrate freshness validation into execution entry points and trigger manifest regeneration when stale or drift is detected, leveraging existing dev_pipeline orchestration and brain_snapshot flow.

stories.title: Internal Freshness Status Interface
stories.description: Provide an internal interface for Brain runner and DevOps flows to query manifest freshness status (fresh/stale, age, last_generated, drift_detected) to enforce pre-execution validation gates.

stories.title: Manifest Freshness Test Suite and Pipeline Integration
stories.description: Develop unit and integration tests covering TTL expiry, hash drift detection, regeneration triggers, and enforcement within Brain runner and pipeline execution paths.
